title: Sublime Systems wins Meta supply contract to help scale low-carbon cement production
summary: Sublime Systems wins Meta supply contract to help scale low-carbon cement production
body_markdown:
**US:** Sublime Systems has signed a multi-year agreement granting Meta priority access to its low-carbon cement for future data centre construction. The agreement, announced on 12 November 2026, includes environmental attribute certificates associated with at least 180,000t of cement production, verified by an accredited third party.


The agreement is intended to provide the forward demand needed to support development of Sublime Systems’ first commercial cement plant in the US. Deliveries will come from its first commercial factories, with the company planning to work with established cement producers to develop plants using its electrochemical manufacturing process.


Rob Davies, CEO of Sublime Systems, said the agreement would support expansion of US cement manufacturing and create jobs in communities hosting the plants.
